# darce.xyz
> Portfolio and case studies for Daniel Arcé.
> Daniel Arcé — Senior Front-End Developer & Design Technologist in Toronto. Production interfaces, accessibility, and working prototypes for media products, photo archives, and image tools.

## Pages
- / — Home
- /work/ — Index of project case studies
- /about/ — Bio, role focus, strengths
- /research/ — Index of technical writing and experiments

## Projects
- /projects/visual-search-workbench/ — Designed and built a SwiftUI app for searching photo folders and following visual neighbours, with linked UMAP, Places, and Timeline views and local Core ML processing.
- /projects/altcontext/ — Developing a React interface, WordPress integration, and Python services that combine photographs, confirmed identities, and page context for editor-reviewed image descriptions.
- /projects/photoshelter/ — Led production accessibility work at PhotoShelter, built keyboard behaviour across Web Components and Shadow DOM, maintained Mocha tests, and developed React workflow prototypes with the Chief Architect and UX team.
- /projects/msnbc/ — Proposed and prototyped browsing around continuous video playback, then helped deliver the responsive AngularJS interface and CMS components with MSNBC’s internal team and external vendors.
- /projects/workbay/ — Built WorkBay to preserve task decisions, review findings, and test evidence across AI coding sessions, with SQLite records, MCP retrieval, and checks on the normal Git development path.
- /projects/apple/ — Implemented responsive iPhone X launch pages from supplied designs, developed a CSS-animated email campaign, and automated campaign build, preview, and deployment steps.
- /projects/texting-syria/ — Built the PHP and Twilio application for Liam Maloney’s Texting Syria installation, delivering previously recorded messages to exhibition visitors’ phones.
- /projects/barbarabeirne/ — Recovered the images embedded in Barbara Beirne’s defunct Flash site in 2023, then rebuilt its web presentation with Web Components, keyboard navigation, and a full-screen carousel in 2026.
- /projects/bauhausdances/ — Designed a film-derived visual treatment and built a custom WordPress theme for Debra McCall’s Bauhaus Dances, with self-hosted video and caching.

## Research
- /research/visual-search-workbench-process/ — How Visual Search Workbench connects search, a UMAP map, and an image grid to help people explore a photo collection and develop a visual direction.
- /research/visual-search-workbench-screen-reference/ — An interaction reference for Visual Search Workbench: begin with words or a picture, follow similar images, and inspect a UMAP map selection in the image grid.
- /research/agent-memory/ — WorkBay separates the stored project record from the retrieval layer that finds it and the context packet a coding session reads.
- /research/interrogating-agent-memory/ — Five recurring questions show how I use WorkBay’s project record to examine an earlier decision before making the next one.
- /research/economics-of-agent-memory/ — An audit snapshot describes WorkBay context packets. A proposed paired comparison tests whether they reduce task token use without lowering quality.
- /research/heuristics-canon/ — Heuristics Canon gives design, engineering, and writing reviews specific triggers and questions, with references that let another reviewer examine the reasoning.
- /research/rotation-matrices/ — A browser experiment that makes rotation matrices and perspective projection, normally abstracted by WebGL, visible using only TypeScript, DOM elements, and CSS transforms
- /research/order-book/ — An interactive guide to bids, asks, spread, and visible market depth using live Binance WebSocket data
